notes: LIVE BALANCES MOVED OUT OF THE GRID, AND THE CLOSE CONTROL MADE FINDABLE. 1. THE THREE ACCOUNT ROWS ARE NOW A STRIP ABOVE THE TABLE, not rows inside it. They are present-tense facts, and inside a month-by-month grid they invited a reading they could not support: a card balance under NOV 26 looks like a forecast of next month's debt. Printing Rs 0 there asserted something false, and the dash that replaced it was no clearer. The strip shows savings, salary and card as they stand right now, with this month's adjustments beneath each where any exist, matching how the Journal already presents them. The month-by-month cash position remains the Cash at end of month row's job. No calculation changed. 2. THE CLOSE CONTROL WAS ALREADY THERE ON BOTH INSTRUMENT TYPES AND HAD BEEN ALL ALONG. The previous release claimed investment rows lacked it and added one; that was wrong on both counts. EMI rows carried it, and investment rows had a second, programmatically created one further down the same function, so the 'fix' produced a duplicate button. The duplicate has been removed. The real problem was never a missing control but an unlabelled one: a 34px circle containing an ellipsis, with its purpose hidden in a tooltip. Nobody finds 'close and redeem' behind that. Both now read 'Close / timeline' on a 44px tall pill, and the badge still marks instruments that already carry lifecycle events. 3. REPEATER FIELDS WERE MISSING THE EARLIER SIZE INCREASE. A .rep-row override set padding 9/11 and 12.5px type, which cancelled the global change on exactly the page where congestion was reported. Those fields are now 12/13 padding, 15px type and 44px minimum height, and their labels went from 9.5px to 10.5px. The Instruments page is still NOT deleted, pending the user's own judgement now that closing works from Edit inputs. Regression confirms the Projection-to-Dashboard and Decisions-to-chain gaps both remain zero. No page errors.
